top_concerns: No ablations isolate the proof-state exploration data from the baseline policy, search implementation or beam size; no data-scaling curve despite the 'scalable' title
Adaptive beam hyperparameters (Bmax/Bmin/lambda) are tuned per benchmark apparently on the test sets; gain over best fixed beam is within noise (60.74 vs 59.51; 21.18 vs 20.75)
Baseline comparison is confounded: data generated by BFS-Prover itself, baselines re-run with the authors' own search code, unequal tactic samples per step, synthesis compute not reported
Decontamination is BLEU-only, with Lean Workbook/STP/Mathlib seeds; no counts, thresholds or semantic check
Only two tree-search baselines; no matched-budget comparison with stronger or recent provers; diversity claim never measured
